decision_scope: Engineering audit of execution custody and of the retained zero-prediction scoring ledger; the custody and ledger checks hold, every finding is non-blocking; not manufacturing approval, calibrated metrology, conformance, generalization or production evidence; no numeric F1 exists and null stays null.

findings.detail: Three slots (CG1E0BBA2933 control/challenger, CG4BDD1371B6 control) reached FULL_RAW_LOCAL_MEASUREMENT through bridge V1 (17/13/13 kernel-V2 features reconstructed from backend.cad_guided_measurement.CADGuidedFeature, no bridge refusal anywhere) and evaluated 43 context windows (13+13+17); all 43 are UNAVAILABLE with failure_phase PLANE_FIT_ROLE_0: 32 FLANGE_NORMAL_WEAK_RELATIVE_TO_RESIDUAL_POLICY, 11 FLANGE_NOT_PLANAR_AT_DECLARED_RESIDUAL; 0 support records, 0 support groups, 0 carriers, 0 predictions; contact-projection diagnostics for these three slots are zeros over zero carriers (identity_unresolved_carrier_count 0, inner_face_eligible_carrier_count 0, subset_registration_count 1, registration_context_count 1, source_context_window_count 13/13/17), null for the other 19 slots. The V9 MG class (cover feature-type guard refusal before any window) did not recur. Retained negative outcome, not a custody issue.

findings.detail: All 22 workers returned (exit 0, budget_stop null, no RESULT_PARTIAL.bin, no supervisor refusal); V9 had 14 SIGXCPU kills. cost_receipts.cpu_guard_tripped is true in 15 slots (CG08506, CG191, CG1E0, CG4FAF, CG64C, CGEBA, CGF41 both arms; CG4BDD control), with the guard stop at process CPU 1501.0-1552.9 s (receipts) and the last stack sample at 1499.7-1500.0 s. Disposition ledgers over the 22 slots: selected 74 = completed 31 + expired 15 (EXPIRED_BY_CPU_GUARD) + omitted 28 (OMITTED_BY_CPU_GUARD) + failed 0 + not_attempted 0; a further 27 passing start groups were omitted deterministically by the lane quotas before refinement (CG191 control 8, CG191 challenger 14, CG4FAF control 5). evaluated_subset_complete true in 16 slots and false in the 6 no-candidate slots; strict candidate_evaluation_complete true only for CG4BDD challenger. CPU-guard stops are timing dependent by declaration and differ between arms (e.g. the expired CG08506 candidate cost 225.19 s CPU in control and 176.74 s in challenger). Omitted/expired candidates are unknown, never rejected.
findings.title: Allowance and CPU guard: zero CPU kills, 15 guard-stopped leaves, 15 expired and 28 omitted candidates remain UNKNOWN

findings.detail: source/backend/cad_guided_mesh_offline_v17.py: native extraction at phase NATIVE_FEATURES (line 581), bridge (line 588-596, refuses only on class/schema/limit faults), then WHOLE_PART_REGISTRATION (line 624), and only afterwards the availability test `features['status'] not in ('AVAILABLE','PARTIAL') or not features['features']` -> NATIVE_FEATURES_UNAVAILABLE (lines 682-684). In CG191DEC7F81, CG4FAF273093 and CG64C412CC73 (both arms) native_features.status is UNAVAILABLE with reason INVALID_NATIVE_SOLID (bridge feature_count 0, no refusal) yet registration ran to the CPU guard in each (worker CPU 1513.90/1513.39, 1502.21/1502.13, 1531.79/1556.23 s; sum 9119.65 s = 38.6 percent of the campaign's 23611.43 s). CG191's supported contexts (surface p95 0.3637/0.3637 mm, the lowest residuals in the campaign) were therefore unmeasurable by construction. Frozen-source and record observation for a successor; no change to this terminal attempt is requested.
findings.title: Frozen V17 order spends the registration allowance before the native-feature availability check (six slots, about 9120 s worker CPU)

findings.detail: The entry states 'the guard tripped in 16 slots', '16 expired' and 'p95 1.20-1.62 mm'. The records give 15 guard-tripped slots (cost_receipts.cpu_guard_tripped), 15 EXPIRED candidates, and inlier_plane_p95_mm 1.195863337229378-1.5500648012727456 mm over the 18 residual-gate rejections (no candidate record carries 1.62; nested context-proximity residual fields were not extracted). findings.detail: Of the 31 completed candidates, 5 were SUPPORTED_CONTEXT (CG191 control cand 0 at 0.3637 mm, CG191 challenger cand 1 at 0.3637 mm, CG1E0 control/challenger cand 0 at 0.8480 mm, CG4BDD control cand 0 at 0.6659 mm) and 26 REJECTED_CONTEXT: 18 by the 1.0 mm gate (SURFACE_RESIDUAL_OUTSIDE_DECLARED_ALGORITHM_GATE, p95 1.196-1.550 mm; 7 of these also INSUFFICIENT_FINITE_SURFACE_SUPPORT) and 8 by finite support only (p95 0.602-0.738 mm inside the gate but CAD coverage 0.457-0.602 / scan coverage lower 0.451-0.599 against min_scan_coverage 0.75). Every completed candidate reused the diagnosis full-scan query exactly once (reused_query_calls 1, REUSED_DIAGNOSIS_FULL_SCAN_QUERY_EXACT_BINDING); chunked_query_calls 0 in all slots. CG4BDD control reproduces V9's admission (0.6658972409525935 mm vs V9 0.6658972409525943 mm; last two digits differ) and CG4BDD challenger V9's rejection (1.195863337229378 vs 1.1958633372293805 mm). Per-candidate refinement cost 193.96-1422.29 s CPU (31 completed, sum 16964.55 s); 15 expired candidates consumed 29.46-1512.91 s (sum 5660.54 s); lane CPU totals completion 15798.64 s, main 6846.26 s.
findings.title: Registration outcome classes from the records (no supported context in 11 slots)

findings.detail: Pose-class dedup and the measurement-context cap (supported = scheduled = 1 in each of the 5 supported slots; cap 6/8); completion-lane rollback (refinement_schedule.lane_transaction null in all 22 slots; initialization cost_receipts.cpu_guard_tripped false everywhere, the guard tripped only inside registration refinement); the stage-checkpoint cap notice (all 22 ledgers truncated false, at most 22 records / 2633 bytes of the 512 / 65536 caps); the completion lane produced no passing child on CG4FAF (0 of 0 and 0 of 14) and no parent on CG65 (as the protocol anticipated); CGE4B never reached the lane (proposals unavailable, unchanged since V8).

method: Only cat, sed -n, grep, shasum -a 256, wc, ls -la/-laT, diff, tar -tvf (listing) and tar -xOf (single-member streaming for hashing), two ps -axo queries, date -u, git status --porcelain on named paths, and .venv/bin/python snippets that read, parse (json), hash, lstat and tabulate files under the attempt directory, the outer records, the external archive directory, the job scratch directory and the named repository documents (the frozen source/ snapshot read with sed/grep only). No runner, projection, scorer, test, freeze, verify, execute, worker or geometry/native code was run and no module under backend/ or scripts/ was imported. Not opened: data/, output/, outputs/, pools/manifests, HOLDOUT10, incoming-email/EHO parts, .env/credentials, /private/tmp/gold11-*, /var/folders/*, and every docs/research/*_attempt* directory other than the V10 attempt.
not_checked: The outer exit observation itself: the waiting parent's record was verified for internal consistency (nonce, pids, timestamps, walls, return path in the frozen runner text), not observed by this reviewer; no crash-proof guarantee is claimed by the waiter and none here.

No runner, projection (gold11_schedule_projection_v5), scorer (gold11_contact_scoring_v4), engine, test, freeze, verify, execute or worker code was executed and no module under backend/ or scripts/ was imported: the inner projections were bound by canonical-hash identity with the retained contact_projection objects, the matcher was not rerun, and the scoring request, inventory and terminal digests were reproduced by data transformation of the retained records.

Raw scan/CAD bytes were not read or hashed; the Gold catalog (data/bend_corpus/annotations) was not opened; input binding rests on the frozen declarations, each receipt's source_binding_valid and the RESULT-embedded cad_sha256 / scan_topology.source_sha256 equal to the frozen case digests. The reference snapshot SELECTED_REFERENCES.json was hashed and its bend counts and scan digests compared; no reference geometry was transcribed.
Private caches under /private/tmp were not stat'ed, listed or opened; two ps queries were run (23:07:04 UTC; none matching); no live-writer check beyond that.
The V9 attempt directory was not opened; V9 figures are from docs/research/2026-09-13_gold11_mesh_development_v9_post_run_audit.md, its addendum and the V9 result narrative only.

Encoded patch_evidence.scan wires, hypotheses, completion_lane.hypotheses, face_index_evidence, unsigned_assignments, two_plane_context/schedule arrays and the per-window flange fit values were not decoded or reviewed beyond counts, statuses, reasons and layer-selection identities; nested context-proximity residual fields of the candidates were not extracted (only geometric coverage fields); no kernel, cover, context, bridge, registration or initializer module was reviewed line by line (their frozen hashes were verified; only the V17 lines cited and the runner inventory/scoring-request text were read).
Sampler policy conformance was not verified beyond counting records and reading the last frame of each slot; sampled CPU/RSS values are not continuous guarantees.

The author's V10 result narrative (docs/research/2026-09-13_gold11_mesh_development_v10_result.md) and the Codex registration postmortem written during this audit were not read; the coordination and diagnosis documents were only grepped for POST expectations.
The correctness of the per-window measurement refusals (FLANGE_NORMAL_WEAK / NOT_PLANAR) as physical statements was not assessed; they are reported as the frozen kernel's retained outputs.

scope_statement: Engineering audit of execution custody and of the retained scoring ledger of a terminal consumed-development attempt (read-only; hashes, JSON parsing, tar listing and member payload streaming, lstat identities, process table, date only).
